summary.intent: Fix PR #634 (branch wp-onboarding-friction, trail #487) so `callisto init` no longer fails with E132 for a non-hosted origin (file:// or local path) and still shows its 'First release preview'; add e2e tests, check git process-count tests, run crate tests and lint, merge origin/main, and push.
summary.outcome: Init now reads origin with `Origin::read(..).preview()`, with new tests for file:// and local-path origins. The work also removed URL echoing from origin/registry errors (MaskedUrl dropped) and scoped the version hint in release_decision.rs. Tests were run and a signed commit was attempted, but the transcript ends before just lint, the git_process_count_tests check, the origin/main merge, the push, ls-remote confirmation, trail linking and the report to the lead.

repo: Origin reading has two semantics: `.optional()` errors with E132 on a non-hosted remote, while `.preview()` (used by release --dry-run) treats a non-hosted origin like no origin.

Init e2e-style tests live in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init/tests.rs (helpers: git, workspace_without_origin, run_init, yes) and crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/tests.rs (detect_in, repo).
Origin binding logic is in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/binding.rs; OriginRefusal and error types are in crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs.
Docs mentioning E132 masking live in docs/specs/release.json and .changeset/tough-pandas-leap.md and had to be updated when the error stopped naming the value.
Repo rules in the task require a worktree, signed commits, no rebase or force-push, and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS of cores/5.

code.finding: Changed `Origin::read(&root, runner)?.optional()?` to `.preview()` so a non-hosted origin no longer aborts init before the first release preview.
`NotHosted` was reduced to a unit variant and the MaskedUrl field removed, so no diagnostic can echo a remote string.
Removed the MaskedUrl type; `UntrustedNpmRegistry` now carries only the package, and `OriginRefusal::NotHosted` is a unit variant with a fixed hint message.

workflow: Multi-line Python edit scripts written inline via heredoc were awkward; writing them to files under the jobs tmp dir and then running them worked better.
The signed commit step had to be retried several times because of fmt hooks and a wrapper (rtk) in the shell.

friction: The first bash command was duplicated and then split; several greps ran before the right code location was found.
The commit was retried four times, with cargo fmt and the rtk wrapper involved, before it landed.
Test runs needed `--no-fail-fast` and repeated filtering to isolate failures.

Scope grew beyond the stated task: the MaskedUrl removal and the version-hint scoping were not in the original request and touch error types and docs, which the rules say need the lead's approval for new error codes, keys and flags.
open_items: Run `just lint` and confirm git_process_count_tests pass; check whether the extra plan_version call in release --dry-run adds a git process per package and make it reuse the existing plan.
Merge origin/main, push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wp-onboarding-friction`, confirm with git ls-remote, link trail #487 and open with `entire trail ci-pr`.
Report PR, sha and commands run to the lead in under 5 lines.
Tell the lead about the extra MaskedUrl removal and version-hint scope changes, which go beyond the original request.
